meta_description:
66K likes, 477 comments - sobhitad on August 26, 2026: "I want to write about quiet rage, about the colour red, about grief that sits under that rage, about wild women, about modern horrors but I’ll park that for another time. I’ll let this Vogue imagery stay with you, when we were chatting about this cover shoot - the editor, the Vogue team and I.. it was clear that we were plotting to bring to life our collective fantasy about today’s Indian woman - a woman who chooses, on her terms. Revolutionary, when you really think about it. How many are really doing that huh 
@vogueindia".
